cs.t: When I moved into my apartment, I went to BestBuy and I was actually able to find a "dumb TV"!  They had ONE in stock, it was Insignia (their house brand) and it was sold as "open box".  I love it and have had no issues with it. That being said, I use an Nvidia Shield TV Pro connected to it, and I had to do similar steps on that to replace the launcher and install my own apps.  I use "ATV Launcher Pro" ( https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=ca.dstudio.atv... ) personally, and it's great. I also use "Send Files to TV" ( https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.yablio.sen... ) so I can download files on my phone and send them to the TV.

I had the same thought but found there are very few TV-size monitors on the market, and the ones there are cost an arm and a leg. There are also very few "dumb" TVs -- we finally got one by Insignia, Best Buy's store brand, which has been fine. If someone knows a better alternative please let me know! Worth clarifying that when I was a kid "TV-size" meant anything above 13", but the times have changed considerably. :)
